name: add_coverage
description: Add or update coverage, exclusion, condition, or rating clauses on the current draft proposal. Call after propose_product. All citations must copy text VERBATIM from sources.yaml. Monetary amounts must be in INR integers.

clause.description: A single clause to add or replace (matched by clauseId if provided).

clauses.description: Multiple clauses to add or replace in one call.

proseSummary.description: Updated plain-language summary. Every number must match a clause value exactly.

sourceCode.description: Exact source_code from sources.yaml (e.g. IRDAI-CYB-G-2024-S3.4, CERT-IN-DIR-2022-6HR).

textSnippet.description: VERBATIM copy of the full_text from sources.yaml for this source_code. Do not paraphrase.

clauseId.description: Stable identifier (e.g. c-001). Auto-assigned if omitted. Reuse the same id to update.

owningEntityType.description: Must be GeneralLiabilityLine for Phase 1 (GL-line cyber coverages).

limitMaxInr.description: Maximum coverage limit in INR. Omit for EXCLUSION/RATING kinds.

deductibleInr.description: Deductible in INR. Must be between 1% and 10% of limitMaxInr, and strictly less than limitMaxInr.

waitingHours.description: Waiting period in hours (Business Interruption only). Must be 8–72.

conditions.description: Condition strings. Extortion coverage MUST include 'law-enforcement-notification'. CERT-In coverage MUST include 'cert-in-6-hour-reporting'. Fines coverage MUST include 'where-insurable-by-law'.

factors.description: Rating factors (RATING kind only). Each value must be 0.50–3.00.

excludesPatternCodes.description: Pattern codes excluded by this exclusion clause.

citations.description: At least one citation per clause. textSnippet must be VERBATIM from sources.yaml.
